page.overview:
Who is Eduard?

is a tiefling who works at the Black Swan in the Erudite quarter of Emon. As an NPC, is played by Aabria Iyengar.

Eduard is a very tall tiefling with skin that is nearly black. He has short white hair and a white goatee. He carries a handkerchief and business cards.

Eduard considers himself a good negotiator. He is very physical with other people to a degree that they find it creepy. According to Gilmore, he is indeed good at business but "falls in love easy".

Eduard approached Dariax, who was in disguise as Tharla Starr, and gave her his card, asking her if she'd be interested in performing at the Black Swan. Dariax, as Tharla, began to negotiate, aided by Fearne and Dorian, but made no commitments. Eduard then left them, disappearing into the crowd.
